title: Hot Cinnamon Rolls  (热气腾腾的肉桂卷)

segments.t: 就在汉娜往回赶的这几分钟里，早起的伊芙琳女士已经下楼来问为什么洗手间水龙头这么凉。泰莎和亚瑟赶紧端出刚出炉的热肉桂卷和热茶，巧妙拖延时间。我们先完整听一遍。
Good morning! Something smells like warm cinnamon all the way upstairs!
Good morning, Miss Evelyn! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.
Sit right down by the sunny window, ma'am! No rush to go upstairs yet!
Actually, I only came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt so chilly.
Chilly? Ah, yes! Our neighborhood water pipes take a gentle morning stretch!
Have a hot cup of tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!
Well, nobody wise says no to warm cinnamon bread at seven in the morning.
Wonderful choice! Would you like honey or apple jam beside it?
Just a little butter, thank you. Why are you looking at your watch, sir?
Me? Oh, I simply love being on time! Seven fourteen is a beautiful minute!
Look through the courtyard window, Arthur. Someone just ran through the gate!
Saved! Excuse me one moment, ma'am, enjoy your hot tea!
现在放慢语速，一句一句品味泰莎和亚瑟机智周到的待客之道。
Good morning! Something smells like warm cinnamon all the way upstairs!
'早上好！一股暖暖的肉桂香气一路飘到楼上去了！'
Good morning, Miss Evelyn! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.
'早上好，伊芙琳女士！我的肉桂卷刚刚出烤箱。'
Sit right down by the sunny window, ma'am! No rush to go upstairs yet!
'快请坐在向阳的窗边吧，夫人！先别急着上楼去！'
Actually, I only came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt so chilly.
'其实，我下楼只是想问问为什么浴室水龙头摸着这么凉。'
Chilly? Ah, yes! Our neighborhood water pipes take a gentle morning stretch!
'微凉？啊，是呀！咱们这片老街区的水管早上都得温柔地伸个懒腰呢！'
Have a hot cup of tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!
'先喝杯热茶、吃个肉桂卷暖和十分钟吧！'
Well, nobody wise says no to warm cinnamon bread at seven in the morning.
'嗯，聪明人可不会在早上七点拒绝热乎乎的肉桂面包。'
Wonderful choice! Would you like honey or apple jam beside it?
'绝佳的选择！您想在旁边配点蜂蜜还是苹果酱呢？'
Just a little butter, thank you. Why are you looking at your watch, sir?
'只要一点点黄油就好，谢谢。先生，您为什么一直看手表呀？'
Me? Oh, I simply love being on time! Seven fourteen is a beautiful minute!
'我吗？噢，我纯粹是热爱守时！七点十四分真是美妙的一分钟啊！'
Look through the courtyard window, Arthur. Someone just ran through the gate!
'快透过庭院窗户往外看，亚瑟。刚有人跑进大门啦！'
Saved! Excuse me one moment, ma'am, enjoy your hot tea!
'得救啦！失陪一小会儿，夫人，请慢用您的热茶！'
听懂了这些幽默又礼貌的表达，我们再连贯听一遍。

Good morning, Miss Evelyn! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.
Sit right down by the sunny window, ma'am! No rush to go upstairs yet!
Actually, I only came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt so chilly.
Chilly? Ah, yes! Our neighborhood water pipes take a gentle morning stretch!
Have a hot cup of tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!
Well, nobody wise says no to warm cinnamon bread at seven in the morning.
Wonderful choice! Would you like honey or apple jam beside it?
Just a little butter, thank you. Why are you looking at your watch, sir?
Me? Oh, I simply love being on time! Seven fourteen is a beautiful minute!
Look through the courtyard window, Arthur. Someone just ran through the gate!
Saved! Excuse me one moment, ma'am, enjoy your hot tea!
亚瑟一边盯着手表一边夸七点十四分是个美妙的时刻，话音刚落，窗外就闪过了汉娜冲进庭院大门的身影！我们下场戏见。
See you later!
